previousReview.scope: Source plus pre-existing uncommitted FIA backfill and accuracy output; no deployed-browser certification
notes: The lock-snapshot fixture disables market influence to isolate the live circuit-model dependency. The 3.6771 point effect is synthetic, not a measured error in a completed race.
Comparison standard errors use independent weekends after averaging seeds.
The current and previous engines agree on the reported repeated-seed backtest metrics with matching current inputs.
Market-check timings are single un-warmed calls; use timings for the five-repeat benchmark.
FIA parser observations use the local stored source text; no independent source authentication was performed.
